analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($154.32) vs SMA5($154.21)/SMA20($133.61)/SMA50($122.92) — testing short-term resistance, above mid-term trend
· Above SMA100($119.11)/SMA200($132.29) — maintaining strong mid-to-long-term trend
· 52-week position (68.4%) + historically mid-range price level
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (71.3→66.8) — cooling from overbought, entering neutral zone
· MACD histogram trajectory (2.7905→2.5867) — holding steady improvement, no trend reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band $133.61) — consolidating around the mid-band
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($145.16) — based on 50-day Moving Average
· Swing Resistance ($156.85) — based on 5-day high, potential for further upside on breakout
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.58x) — reduced confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (short-term consolidation within uptrend) — buy on breakout above $156.85, watch for sell-off on break below $145.16 support
